turns.reply: I changed `Console.print()` in `rich/console.py` so that calling it with no objects renders `""` with the given `end`, instead of always emitting a newline. `print(end="")` now outputs nothing, and the default still outputs `"\n"`. `tests/test_console.py` passes (99 tests). I did not drop Python 3.8 support, since the issue's second item is outside the code fix.
